These are **synthetic** pages modelled on the structure observed on
bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd (title in h3, act number in h4, date in [ ], chapter
headings as plain text, section links to /act-{id}/section-{sid}.html, plus a
nav bar and footer). The legal text is abbreviated.

Once you have run the scraper, replace/add fixtures by copying real pages from
data/raw/ — tests against real HTML are the ones that matter.
